title: Samphassasuttaṃ
text: 325 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . ‘‘Yo, bhikkhave, cakkhusamphassasmiṃ chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso. Yo sotasamphassasmiṃ… yo ghānasamphassasmiṃ… yo jivhāsamphassasmiṃ… yo kāyasamphassasmiṃ… yo manosamphassasmiṃ chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso. Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno…pe… abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesū’’ti. Catutthaṃ.
